title: Disc Improvements
description: A small pack that retextures the default music discs to improve and differentiate them, using vanilla+ changes that look like minecraft themselves could make.
body:
Changed discs:
- cat
- Pigstep
- Otherside
- Relic
- Lava Chicken
- Tears
- Bounce

I will continue to update this pack as Mojang adds more discs to the game, and if you have suggestions for any changes I could make you can message me on discord (username is minorspellingmistake).

Happy disc listening!
